one_line_reason: Multiple RCTs and a 2026 meta-analysis show oral white kidney bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) alpha-amylase inhibitor extract reduces weight/fat mass in overweight adults.

selected.population: adults with overweight/obesity (meta-analysis of 8 RCTs, n=543)
selected.primary_outcome: body weight, BMI, fat mass, waist/hip circumference
selected.why_selected: largest, most recent synthesis (2026 meta-analysis) directly on oral WKBE and weight/adiposity outcomes.

selected.population: adults with overweight and moderate obesity (n=81 completers)
selected.intervention: proprietary standardized WKBE (Phase 2), oral capsules before meals, 12 weeks, during calorie-restricted diet
selected.dose_as_stated: 1000 mg (high dose) or 700 mg (low dose), three times daily
selected.primary_outcome: body weight, fat mass, BMI, waist/hip/thigh circumference
selected.why_selected: well-powered dose-ranging RCT with clear, label-mappable doses and positive dose-dependent result.

selected.intervention: standardized WKBE water extract (Phaseolean), oral, before each of 3 meals, 45 days
selected.primary_outcome: body weight, BMI, skinfold fat thickness, waist/hip/thigh circumference
selected.why_selected: second independent branded-extract RCT with positive, dose-labeled weight-management result; notably lower dose outperformed higher dose.

selected.population: adults with type 2 diabetes (n=90 randomized, 55 completed maintenance phase)
selected.intervention: white common bean extract (WCBE), oral, before a meal, 4-month RCT
selected.primary_outcome: glycosylated hemoglobin, diabetic peripheral neuropathy indicators, gut microbiota
selected.why_selected: adds a glycemic/complications outcome distinct from weight loss, with a clearly stated dose; population is a clinical (T2D) subgroup rather than general use.

blockers: Effective extracts are branded/standardized preparations (Phase 2, Phaseolean) whose specific alpha-amylase-inhibitor potency may not match a generic catalog WCBE product.
Doses vary widely across trials (700 mg to 3000 mg/day) with no single consistent label amount to anchor a claim.
One selected trial (36303868) is in a type 2 diabetes clinical population rather than general supplement users.

excluded_pmids.reason: Systematic review of multiple herbal medicines (Moringa, pomegranate, Schisandra, etc.) and gut microbiota in obesity; the white common bean extract component specifically showed no significant anthropometric or biomarker changes, and the review is not a dedicated single-ingredient efficacy trial.
